Parallel walls, scale bar and top-down room/courtyard outlines establish orthographic projection. Coordinates use the native 720 by 480 page, with its 90-degree display rotation removed. transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: Politecnico di Milano repository paper in Defensive Architecture of the Mediterranean XVI (2024), PDF page 11, figure 3.
